title: WritersProof Evidence Chain Assertion
description: C2PA custom assertion containing the temporal checkpoint chain with per-checkpoint cryptographic seals. Label: com.writerslogic.evidence-chain

checkpointCount.description: Number of checkpoints in the evidence chain

chainDurationSec.description: Wall-clock seconds between first and last checkpoint

sealHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the checkpoint state (commits to content hash, jitter binding, and chain predecessor)

seals.description: Ordered array of per-checkpoint seals binding evidence to time

sessionStats.description: Aggregate session statistics across the evidence chain

sessionCount.description: Number of editing sessions (gaps >30 min separate sessions)

timeSpanSec.description: Wall-clock span from first to last event
